title: artemisia vulgaris subsp. verlotiorum
intro: Artemisia vulgaris subsp. verlotiorum, commonly known as Wormwood, is a subspecies of the mugwort plant, a perennial herb native to Asia and Europe. The health benefits of Wormwood include its use in treating digestive issues, such as bloating and indigestion, and its potential in reducing inflammation and fighting off parasites. The therapeutic actions of Wormwood include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, making it useful for treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Wormwood include compounds such as thujone, artemisinin, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
